purpose: source-length paired-seed test of whether a large initial event-rate difference persists as a stable long-time conductivity difference

pair_provenance.selection_rule: maximum nonnegative-barrier aggregate-rate ratio within the frozen 0.25 meV mean-barrier tolerance at comp=0.9

primary_endpoint.name: late_window_median_conductivity_mS_cm
primary_endpoint.paired_contrast: high_initial_rate_structure divided by low_initial_rate_structure within seed
primary_endpoint.directional_confirmation_rule: all three paired ratios exceed 1 only after both runs in every pair pass the convergence gate

convergence_gate.relative_drift_definition: absolute difference between late and preceding window medians divided by max(abs(late median), 1e-30)
convergence_gate.run_pass_rule: all four metrics are finite throughout both windows and satisfy their frozen drift threshold
convergence_gate.pair_pass_rule: both structure runs for a seed pass
convergence_gate.study_pass_rule: all six runs and all three seed pairs pass

reporting_policy: retain all seeds, direction reversals, non-finite values, and failed convergence gates
report per-pass curves and both frozen window medians for every run
report paired ratios individually; three seeds do not justify asymptotic significance claims
a failed convergence gate is an informative underdetermined result, not an exclusion criterion
interpretation_boundary: This experiment can test transport separation inside the pinned fitted kMC model. It cannot by itself identify the physical mechanism, validate the fitted energy landscape, or establish experimental pellet conductivity.
sealed_test_interaction: This production run does not access or alter the paper-level sealed claim benchmark.
